verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a Profile Builder that generates unified customer profiles (traits, event history up to a year) stored in the warehouse, and profiles are queryable via SQL since they land in the customer's own warehouse tables, plus a Functions API (ctx.getWarehouse) to query warehouse data. However, there is no documented dedicated 'Profile API' or profile store/endpoint — access is only via the underlying warehouse SQL, and no OpenAPI/API reference for profiles was found (openapi probes 404). missing for 10: a documented profile-specific query API or SDK, dedicated identifier-resolution endpoints, independent/hands-on confirmation of profile querying beyond vendor docs.
